audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track featuring bright synth stabs and a strong 4/4 electronic drum beat. A male narrator enters immediately with an energetic, friendly, and high-arousal vocal delivery, articulating Traditional Chinese clearly. (2) As the narration continues, short digital 'bubble' and 'ui' sound effects are interspersed to emphasize the visual transitions. The BGM remains constant in energy and volume, sitting comfortably below the clear vocal track. (3) During the eating sequences, subtle foley-like sounds of crunching or slurping are audible, likely enhanced in post-production to create an ASMR-like effect. The narrator's pitch rises when expressing excitement about the food quality. (4) Toward the end, the acoustic texture shifts slightly as the narrator describes the private room, maintaining high enthusiasm. The music reaches a crescendo before a final hard cut, leaving the listener with a positive and high-energy impression of the dining experience.
